description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) profiles, including ClassID, Service, and Tree, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and management of Bluetooth SDP services and attributes.

classes.name: ClassID
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Class ID with methods for comparison and name retrieval.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP Service with attributes, serialization, and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: Manages a collection of Bluetooth SDP services, allowing addition and lookup.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Provides methods for discovering and querying Bluetooth SDP services over a socket.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Abstract class for Bluetooth SDP server handling PDU requests and managing service tree.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers services on a Bluetooth device.

methods.name: ServiceSearch
methods.description: Performs a service search for specified UUIDs.

methods.name: ServiceAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a specific service handle.

methods.name: ServiceSearchAttribute
methods.description: Performs combined service search and attribute retrieval.

methods.name: WithServiceTree
methods.description: Configures the server with a service tree.

methods.name: OnPDU
methods.description: Handles incoming PDU requests based on PDU type.
